hints.title: Total Distinct Count
hints.text: First determine the total number of distinct elements present in the entire array.

hints.title: Sliding Subarray Window
hints.text: Expand the right pointer while tracking frequency counts of numbers inside the current window.

hints.title: Shrink Left Pointer
hints.text: When the window contains all k distinct values, every prefix extending from 0 up to left is complete, so add left to the total.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Two-pointer sliding window with hash map frequency tracking.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all O(n^2) subarrays with set construction takes cubic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) time using two pointers and O(k) space for frequency storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use two pointers to count all valid starting positions for each valid ending position.
